svg.aria-label: The six laws. joint_move: two tags written inside the ordinary band, close together in time. subfloor_walk: one tag stepped across that band for a fixed length. band_handoff: the same ordinary value on a second tag later, and no booking names both tags. program_transfer: a download, an upload, or an online edit, and nothing booked covers that act. allowed_writer: a write from a station the plant did not name. controller_valve: a valve that is not the value the plant's own comparison writes.
